implemented_capabilities.capability: Exploit-plane compiler: compiles Kubernetes/cloud posture into :EXPLOIT_STEP edges with virtual super-source and super-sink
implemented_capabilities.notes: Parameter-free parameterized Cypher MERGE passes that derive attack edges (INITIAL_ACCESS, NET_RCE, RBAC escalation, host escape, IRSA AssumeRole) from the inventory layer; this is a rule set, not a learned model. Only the first ~140 lines were read in detail; later passes were taken from architecture.md and method names.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Minimum-disruption attack-path severing via cutting-plane hitting-set MILP with counterfactual sandbox verification
implemented_capabilities.notes: min sum c_m x_m s.t. each active path is hit and required-dependency edges are forbidden (cost 999 / excluded); each iteration re-queries paths, solves with scipy milp, applies mutations on a GRAPH.COPY sandbox, recompiles, and adds cuts for surviving paths until zero remain. Costs per remediation class are a hard-coded table. Self-reported benchmark: 14 exploit edges and 2 simple paths in the test graph (very small).

implemented_capabilities.capability: Verification gate and operator approval/veto memory
implemented_capabilities.notes: commit_verified_remediation refuses unless a VERIFIED_IN_MODEL simulation exists for the exact (snapshot_sha, candidate_set_id); operator decisions are persisted as RemediationRecord nodes in a 'sentinel_memory' graph with stable_key, edge_keys, expires_at and cluster_id, and unexpired REJECTED_BY_OPERATOR records mark candidates forbidden in later solves. The gate state is an in-process Python set (lost on restart), and record_operator_decision swallows write errors (bare except: pass). 'Commit' only validates (kubeconform + re-ingest) and logs; no kubectl apply.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Prompt-injection hardening for LLM tool use
implemented_capabilities.notes: Untrusted strings wrapped in <untrusted_data> tags with regex credential redaction and 2048-char truncation, 5 tool calls per turn, operator-decision tool never exposed to the model, and constraint updates need a verbatim substring of the user prompt. Reported 0/50 attack success is self-measured on its own suite.

implemented_capabilities.capability: K8s manifest / Trivy / Prowler ingestion with RBAC pre-flattening and CNI NetworkPolicy reachability truth table
implemented_capabilities.notes: Uses yaml.safe_load_all; derives :CAN_REACH_NET edges from NetworkPolicy semantics (default allow, isolated-if-selected). parser.py (36 KB) and cni_resolver.py were not read line by line; behaviour taken from architecture.md plus grep evidence.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Minimal-diff NetworkPolicy / RBAC / IAM remediation manifest generation
implemented_capabilities.notes: Generates YAML text from the selected severed edges and existing policy state; correctness against a real cluster is not demonstrated beyond kind fixtures in deploy/kind/.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Gemini-driven 7-tool MCP agent, flight recorder and FastAPI command-centre UI
implemented_capabilities.notes: Seven typed tools wrapping the engine; endpoints /health, /scenarios, /sessions/init, /sessions/{id}(/stream), /graph/{name}, /agent/run, /operator/decision. Has a replay_mode (scripted) when no BYOK key is supplied, so demos without a key are replays.

graph_models_and_cypher: Two layers in FalkorDB (16 node labels / 16 relationship types per architecture.md and backend/schema.py): Layer 1 inventory/posture (Workload, ServiceAccount, RBACRole, Service, Ingress, EntryPoint, CrownJewel, IAMRole, WorkerNode, ... with CAN_REACH_NET, USES_SA, BOUND_TO, MOUNTS_HOST, ASSUMES_IAM_ROLE, REQUIRED_DEPENDENCY, ALLOWS_API, EXPOSES, ROUTES_TO, SELECTS) and Layer 2 :EXPLOIT_STEP edges {step_type, technique, mechanism, cost} between :VirtualSource and :VirtualSink. Cypher uses $params; mutation Cypher is stored per candidate (MATCH ... DELETE r). Uses FalkorDB-specific algo.SPpaths({sourceNode,targetNode,relTypes}) and GRAPH.COPY for sandboxes; query() uses ro_query for reads. find_shortest_paths builds the MATCH label/property names via f-string from keyword arguments with defaults (values are params). compose.yaml uses falkordb/falkordb:latest (unpinned). NOTE: LastLift's docs (docs/falkordb-sppaths-note.md) report algo.SPpaths on FalkorDB 4.22.0 running for hours and ignoring query timeout on dense graphs, so Fjord's reliance on it is a risk on Kairos' 4.22 server.
algorithms: Cutting-plane minimum-cost hitting-set ILP (scipy.optimize.milp) with per-path cuts and sandbox-derived additional cuts in backend/solver/ilp_solver.py:CuttingPlaneILPSolver.solve
Counterfactual verification by GRAPH.COPY + mutate + recompile + path recount in backend/solver/sandbox.py:SandboxManager.simulate
Virtual super-source / super-sink reduction so one algo.SPpaths call covers all entry-to-asset paths (backend/db/connection.py:find_shortest_paths)
NetworkPolicy default-allow/isolation truth table in backend/ingest/cni_resolver.py
Operator-veto filtering with expiry (expires_at > now) in ilp_solver.py:enumerate_candidates
backend_interfaces: FastAPI: GET /, GET /health, GET /scenarios, POST /sessions/init, GET /sessions/{id}, GET /sessions/{id}/stream, GET /graph/{graph_name}, POST /agent/run, POST /operator/decision (backend/api/router.py)
Benchmarks CLI benchmarks/run_all_benchmarks.py (eval_agent, eval_compiler, eval_faithfulness, eval_injection)
frontend_interfaces: Single-page 3-pane 'command centre' HTML/JS embedded in backend/api/app.py (inline script; BYOK Gemini key textbox, SSE stream)
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Gemini tool-calling agent with per-turn quota, untrusted-data wrapping, verification gate, flight-recorder JSONL log, and a persistent 'sentinel_memory' FalkorDB graph storing operator ACCEPT/REJECT decisions with expiry and cluster scope that later bias the solver. In-memory _candidate_action_registry holds candidate sets between tool calls.
tests_present: tests/ has ~32 test functions across test_ilp_solver.py (8), test_compiler_monotonicity.py (6), test_agent_tools.py (7), test_api.py (4), test_audit_hardening.py (4), test_graph_integrity.py (2) plus tests/task0_vertical_slice.py; needs live FalkorDB; benchmarks compare against a NetworkX simple-path oracle. Not executed by auditor.
security_findings: backend/api/app.py:20 - CORS allow_origins=['*'] on the API.
backend/api/router.py:53,189 - accepts a user-supplied BYOK Gemini API key in the request body (byok_api_key); keys transit the server and must not be logged.

backend/api/router.py:415-440 - /operator/decision is protected only by a per-session UI token compared with plain != (not constant-time); operator identity is hard-coded 'SecurityOperator_Local' (no real user identity) and the route never passes expires_at/stable_key/edge_keys to record_operator_decision, so HTTP-recorded vetoes are not scoped or expiring.

backend/agent/tools.py:534-548 - subprocess.run(['kubeconform','-summary', tmp_path]) with list args (no shell) on LLM-influenced YAML written to a temp file; low risk but executes an external binary.
backend/agent/orchestrator.py:~100-125 - sentinel_memory write wrapped in try/except: pass; failed approval/veto writes are silent.
backend/agent/guardrails.py - verification gate is an in-process set; it is lost on restart and not bound to a snapshot content hash.
backend/solver/sandbox.py / ilp_solver.py - mutation_cypher strings are stored on actions and executed on sandboxes; they are code-generated with $params, not user text.
docker-compose.yml - uses falkordb/falkordb:latest (unpinned); port bound to 127.0.0.1 only.
backend/ingest/parser.py:68,602 - uses yaml.safe_load(_all) (good). No eval/exec/pickle found.
No hard-coded secrets found; GEMINI_API_KEY read from env.
duplicates_or_overlaps: Attack-path discovery and remediation (Security & Vulnerability), overlapping other attack-path / blast-radius entries; the min-cost hitting-set remediation planner with counterfactual sandbox, verification gate and expiring operator vetoes is the distinctive piece. Overlaps conceptually with LastLift's GRAPH.COPY what-if pattern.
evidence_drift_relevance: MEDIUM - guardrails.py gates commits on a verified simulation tied to (snapshot_sha, candidate_set_id) and ilp_solver.py honours operator vetoes with expires_at/cluster scope, which is approval gating and decision memory; but the gate is in-memory, there is no supersession or dependency-invalidation cascade, and snapshot staleness is not re-checked at commit.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: A compact, well-documented min-cost hitting-set remediation planner over graph paths, with hard-invariant exclusion, sandbox re-verification loop and persistent expiring vetoes; the same pattern ('choose the cheapest set of edges/dependencies to cut or re-verify') fits Kairos blast-radius remediation and Evidence Drift re-verification planning. Pair with guardrails.GuardrailManager for the verify-before-commit gate.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB (algo.SPpaths, GRAPH.COPY) plus numpy/scipy; path-source could be swapped for a pure-Python path finder to avoid the 4.22 SPpaths hang risk

strategy_rationale: The hitting-set planner, sandbox verification loop and verify-before-commit gate are generic and can be extracted as a Kairos remediation/re-verification engine, but the K8s compiler and ingest are a Security & Vulnerability domain pack, and the algo.SPpaths dependency must be replaced or bounded for FalkorDB 4.22.
